requested_changes.body: Why not just return error or panic instead if we detect CREATE or ERROR for REDIS_POOL_ON_EMPTY_BEHAVIOR? Othewise, users who had set REDIS_POOL_ON_EMPTY_BEHAVIOR=ERROR/CREATE will just experience indefinite blocking.
REDIS_PERSECOND_SENTINEL_AUTH should be mentioned in README.md too I think
